Job Description
 Ciklum is looking for a .NET Engineer to join our team full-time in Romania.
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 About The Role
 As a .NET Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
This project is with a global Financial Services Provider that focuses on providing responsible credit to underbanked customers in international markets. The current strategy centers on consolidating technology delivery to a single partner to drive efficiency and operational excellence.
You will join the Product Engine team. This bespoke, cloud-native system manages the entire credit lifecycle. Built on a modern tech stack and cloud infrastructure, it supports hundreds of thousands of active credit card customers and is being expanded to replace legacy systems for instalment loans across multiple markets.
 Responsibilities
Experience of utilizing automated deployment methods
Communicate effectively with both technical peers and delivery team stakeholders
Forge close links with architects, developers, analysts and wider team members within the development team
Prioritize workloads and maintain self-sufficiency
Identify and escalate key issues as required to maintain project momentum
 Requirements
Minimum 2 years' experience in this role and of developing .NET applications
Novice proficiency in .NET Core, C#, REST APIs, HTML/CSS, React, ASP.Net MVC, and Unit Testing / TDD
Novice knowledge of AWS components: API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, Fargate, S3, Aurora RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation, Load Balancers, Route 53, SQS, SNS, EC2, Kinesis, IAM, and SSM parameter store/Secrets manager
Novice proficiency in Azure DevOps Pipelines, Docker, and Git/source control
Mandatory Certification: Valid AWS Certified Developer – Associate certificate required within 6 months of start
Soft skills: Expert level fluent English and Competent level attention to detail
 Desirable
Competent proficiency in JIRA / Confluence and SCRUM software development processes.
Novice proficiency in AWS monitoring tools: Elastic Search service & Kibana, and CloudWatch.
 What’s in it for you?
Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
Care: Medical subscription to Regina Maria, meal tickets of 40 ron net/day worked
 About Us
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
In Romania, we welcome top-tier tech talent — whether from our Bucharest office or fully remotely. Tap into deep industry knowledge, grow your career, and make an impact in an empowering environment.
 Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.
